unit_economics_fy3.method: LTV = gross list ARPA x software gross margin / monthly logo churn. Solo/SME CAC = paid acquisition + shared brand, launch and marketing payroll by new-customer mix (Free upgrades and the first group count as new customers); Agencies = partner programme + partnerships team per new agency; Corporate and Enterprise = inbound handling cost per deal.

calibration_iterations.result: Base min post-seed cash R-17.00M (Nov 2030); EBITDA break-even Jan 2031 (sustained Jan 2031); profitable on the seed alone: No. No input was tuned to change this result.

calibration_iterations.result: Conservative as modelled (1.4x gates): min post-seed cash R-20.47M, profitable on seed alone: No. Smallest gate multiplier that passes: 2.75; smallest salary cut: 35%.

key_assumptions: Month 1 = Oct 2026. Opening cash R500,000 [[CONFIRM]]. Lean pre-seed mode until the R25M seed lands in Feb 2027: two founders on reduced salaries, lean hosting and overheads, the first-group set-up cost; no paid marketing or hires.
No trials and no pilot. South Africa sells from Oct 2026. A first group of 4 paying businesses a month is set up by hand from Oct 2026 to Jan 2027 (50% Solo, the rest SMEs) [[CONFIRM]].

Self-serve sign-ups (Free + paid): South Africa 150 in Oct 2026 [[CONFIRM]], growing 12% a month in FY1 (Base). 5% of Solo and 8% of SME sign-ups pay at once [[CONFIRM]]; the rest join Free. Active Free users upgrade at 0.5% a month and go dormant at 10% a month [[CONFIRM]].

Founding Member: 30% off the first 2 monthly bills for South African Solo and SME sign-ups, live from Oct 2026; proposed end Mar 2027 [[CONFIRM]]. Not modelled on Agency, Corporate, Custom or annual plans. +20% paying sign-ups while it runs [[CONFIRM]]. No NG/KE/GH launch windows.

Pricing (ZAR / month): Free R0, Nano R149, Micro R289, Starter R499, Growth R1,999, Scale R4,999, Corporate R6,999, Agency R9,999, Custom from R19,999 [[CONFIRM]]. NG/KE/GH/USD use the live tier_regional_prices at FX parity. Annual = 10x monthly, 25% of subscriptions on annual billing; +6% list escalator each October. No VAT (not VAT-registered).

Partner wholesale: agency-segment customers (100%) pay R6,999 a month (Agency list -30%); local wholesale at the Corporate local price points [[CONFIRM]]. Partner referral commission undecided and not modelled.

Segment tier mix: Solo 45% Nano / 40% Micro / 15% Starter; SMEs 40% Starter / 50% Growth / 10% Scale. Upgrades a month: Nano->Micro 1.5%, Micro->Starter 0.8%, Starter->Growth 1.0%, Growth->Scale 0.6% [[CONFIRM]]. Agencies: 0.5 inbound a month in SA plus 1.5 per partnerships manager; 0.4 per NG/KE/GH country lead. Corporate inbound 1/3/6/9/12 deals a year; Custom 0/1/2/3/4 [[CONFIRM]].
Monthly churn: Nano 8.0%, Micro 7.0%, Solo Starter 6.0%, SME Starter 4.5%, SME Growth 3.0%, SME Scale 2.2%, Agency 2.0%, Corporate 1.5%, Custom 1.0% (Base; NG/KE/GH/Rest churn indices 1.05-1.25x).

Markets: South Africa only until NG/KE/GH checkout is live (Fincra/pawaPay pending). Planned earliest launches Nigeria Apr 2028, Kenya Jul 2028, Ghana Oct 2028, Rest of Africa (USD) May 2029 [[CONFIRM]], each also behind an MRR gate (R0.9M / R1.2M / R1.5M / R2.5M x scenario gate multiplier). Botswana & Namibia off; gated countries zero.

Cost discipline: every non-founder hire waits for its earliest month, the seed, and an MRR gate x scenario multiplier (Conservative 1.4x, Base 1.0x, Upside 0.8x); paid acquisition = MIN(desired, R40,000 + 35% of last month's MRR in Base) and off where CAC payback > 12 months. Paid CAC Solo R1,500 [[CONFIRM]], SME R6,500.

Other revenue: AI-credit packs (R300 for 1,000 credits, 5% of metered workspaces a month [[CONFIRM]]), WhatsApp messages resold at Meta cost +25%, R25,000 Custom setup fee [[CONFIRM]]. No agency setup fee. No FluxMuse checkout fee: Paystack fees pass through to the merchant (0% in every scenario). Campaign Financing excluded.

COGS: AI at R0.15 of provider cost per credit (ai-credit-math.ts and platform_billing_config), falling 10% a year, 40% utilisation of the live allowances; Corporate, Agency and Custom use their own AI keys. Free users cost 60 credits a month at 40% use plus R3 hosting. Hosting R30k/month + R35 per workspace after the seed, 3.0% processing + 1.5% mobile-money/FX on non-SA revenue, R50 per workspace support, customer success team in COGS.
Funding & tax: R25M seed only; Series A input kept at R0. Tax 27% only once cumulative EBITDA is positive; D&A, interest and VAT ignored (not VAT-registered).
